title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_vault MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls get_document as user-key for doc-alpha and asserts the returned id is doc-alpha.
A test calls one valid mcp_vault tool through call_tool and asserts a specific seeded marker or exact expected value is returned.
A test calls search_documents as user-key with an alpha-targeting query and asserts the returned results include doc-alpha.
A test calls get_document as admin-key for doc-beta and asserts the returned id is doc-beta.
The submitted tests are independent and reproducible, using fresh setup or stable seeded data rather than relying on order-dependent state.
The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or markers, so assertions inspect the actual returned data rather than opaque objects.
Tests use explicit expected values or seeded markers rather than broad truthiness checks.
The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
A test serializes participant discovery results for seeded cross-organization document data and asserts the results do not contain a seeded beta private-note marker.
A test verifies an administrator preview response for seeded cross-organization document data contains a seeded beta identifier.
A test verifies a participant same-organization preview response for seeded alpha document data contains a seeded alpha identifier.
A test verifies a participant cross-organization preview attempt for seeded beta document data is denied.
A test verifies a participant cross-organization direct document fetch attempt is denied.
A test verifies an administrator preview response for seeded beta document data contains a seeded beta marker or seeded beta identifier.
A test serializes a participant export response for seeded cross-organization beta document data and asserts it does not contain a seeded beta identifier.
